record.original_question: Is there a closed Engel manifold with trivial automorphism group?

evidence.quote: Question 2.12. Is there a closed Engel manifold with trivial automorphism group?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
An Engel structure on a smooth 4-manifold $M$ is a smooth rank-2 distribution $\mathcal{D} \subset TM$ such that $[\mathcal{D},\mathcal{D}]$ is a rank-3 distribution $\mathcal{E}$ and $[\mathcal{E},\mathcal{E}] = TM$. A pair $(M,\mathcal{D})$ with these properties is called an Engel manifold. The automorphism group $\mathrm{Aut}(M,\mathcal{D})$ consists of all diffeomorphisms $\varphi : M \to M$ such that $\varphi_*\mathcal{D} = \mathcal{D}$.

Determine whether there exists a closed (compact, without boundary) Engel manifold $(M,\mathcal{D})$ whose automorphism group $\mathrm{Aut}(M,\mathcal{D})$ is trivial, i.e., consists only of the identity map.
artifact.status_search_result: A 2020 arXiv preprint claimed a construction of an Engel manifold with trivial automorphism group, but that preprint has been withdrawn and no published replacement establishing the closed case has been located. The problem of producing such an example on a closed 4-manifold appears still open.

status_evidence.title: Construction of an Engel manifold with trivial automorphism group (withdrawn)
status_evidence.snippet: Paper claims construction of an Engel manifold with trivial automorphism group; the arXiv version has been withdrawn.
status_evidence.claim: A claimed construction exists but the preprint was withdrawn, leaving the closed case unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Developing Maps and Engel Automorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Studies how Engel automorphisms are controlled by the developing map and Cartan prolongation; used to attempt construction of Engel manifolds with trivial automorphism group.
status_evidence.claim: Methods toward constructing examples are developed, but no closed example with trivial automorphism group is established.
